sources.title: The Block — ETHGas raises $12M in token round as it launches Ethereum blockspace futures market with $800M in liquidity commitments (17 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 17 Dec 2025 (page also shows an 'updated' stamp of Oct 2026; only the Dec 2025 facts are used). $12M seed sold entirely as a SAFT token round, July–Aug 2025, led by Polychain; also Stake Capital, BlueYard, Lafayette Macro Advisors, SIG DT, Amber Group. Unannounced ~$5M pre-seed mid-2024. Valuation not disclosed; no board seats. ~$800M of 'commitments' are blockspace supplied by validators, builders and relays, not cash. 18 contributors, about half in Hong Kong. Spun out of Infinity Exchange, a fixed-income protocol that is paused. Validators can sell up to 64 blocks ahead. Revenue: 5% fee on blockspace futures trades. Founder: 'ETA Q1 for full rollout'; model has run on mainnet but is not broadly deployed.

sources.title: Cointelegraph — ETHGas raised $12M as it launches Buterin-proposed gas futures (18 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Blocks split into 240 pieces of 50ms; claimed >10,000 TPS, capacity limited until more validators join. Execution guarantees tested on mainnet, broad deployment not before Jan/Feb 2026. Validators post ETH or EigenLayer-restaked collateral and can be slashed. Founder claims 99.96% of preconfirmations honoured; Cointelegraph could not verify. Founder acknowledges 'some centralizing vectors'; builders/relays such as Titan and Ultrasound process perhaps 50% of blocks. Vitalik Buterin had discussed an on-chain gas futures market.

sources.title: ForkLog — Ethereum gas to become tradable asset with GWEI token launch (14 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: ETHGas Foundation announced GWEI on 13 Jan 2026 as a governance token. Total supply 10B. Allocation: Ecosystem 31%, Investors 27%, Team 22%, Community 10%, Foundation 8%, Advisors 2%. Holders vote on parameters, upgrades and treasury allocations. Airdrop snapshot 19 Jan.

sources.title: ChainCatcher — GWEI airdrop checker live; claims open 21 Jan; tokenomics and vesting (21 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Total supply 10B. Ecosystem 31% (10-year linear); Investors 27% (1-year lock, 10% at cliff, then 2-year linear); Team 22% (same); Community 10% (4-year linear); Foundation 8% (unlocked on day one); Advisors 2% (same as team). Airdropped GWEI auto-staked for 30 days; lock 1 week–4 years for veGWEI. Claims from 21 Jan 2026 21:00 UTC+8.

sources.title: MEXC News / PANews — ETHGas announces GWEI and Genesis Harvest airdrop (13 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Timestamp 13 Jan 2026. Fixed supply 10B. Allocation stated as 50% ecosystem and community, 25% core team, 20% investors (incl. Polychain and Amber), 5% advisors; 10% of supply for community airdrops. veGWEI for governance. 'Proof of Pain' airdrop weighted by historical gas spend and social participation; snapshot 19 Jan 2026 00:00 UTC.

sources.title: BlockEden.xyz — ETHGas 'Proof of Pain' airdrop and GWEI blockspace futures (23 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Circulating at launch 1.75B GWEI (17.5% of 10B). Listed on Binance Alpha, Bitget and MEXC. Allocation and vesting as GWEI-05. Products: inclusion and execution preconfirmations, whole-block commitments, cash-settled base-fee futures. Founder Kevin Lepsoe previously led structured derivatives at Morgan Stanley and Barclays Capital. Risks noted: MEV attack vectors, centralisation of forward blockspace, possible CFTC-style derivatives scrutiny, unproven 3ms settlement claim. No exploit or enforcement action mentioned.

sources.title: Yellow.com — Coinbase opens spot trading for ETHGas (GWEI) (23 Feb 2026, 20:57)
sources.excerpt: Coinbase Markets announced GWEI-USD spot trading from Tue 24 Feb 2026, 09:00 PT, two weeks after roadmap addition on 11 Feb; ERC-20 on Ethereum; also on Coinbase Futures. At 'current prices' ~$0.030, market cap ~$53M, circulating ~1.75B (17.5%, per CoinMarketCap), max supply 10B. Early investor average cost ~$0.0063. Binance launched a GWEI perpetual on 29 Jan; later futures listings offered up to 50x.

sources.title: KuCoin blog — What is ETHGas (GWEI)? (22 Jan 2026; exchange promotional content)
sources.excerpt: Promotional exchange post, unsourced figures. 'Controlled initial release of 17.5%'; price up ~90% within 24h of listing; market cap 'hovering near' $50M. Investors named: Polychain, Amber. Stakers 'said to benefit' from blockspace marketplace fees; airdrop has a 30-day staking period.

circulating_supply.note: 17.5% of 10B, per CoinMarketCap as quoted on 23 Feb 2026; matches the launch figure in GWEI-07

total_supply.note: announced fixed supply; not read on-chain (Etherscan unreachable for this review)

market_cap_usd.note: pre-listing snapshot in a 23 Feb 2026 article at ~$0.030; exact timestamp of the price not given

team_vesting_months.note: 12-month lock, 10% at cliff, then 24 months linear, from TGE 21 Jan 2026

insider_allocation_pct.note: team 22 + investors 27 + advisors 2 + Foundation 8 (Foundation fully liquid at TGE and project-controlled, counted as insider as in the Hyperliquid example). Excluding the Foundation it is 51%.

investor_allocation_pct.note: consistent with GWEI-13's ~$0.0063 average investor cost: ($12M seed + ~$5M pre-seed, GWEI-01) / 2.7B tokens = $0.0063

unlock_90d_pct_of_circ.note: 24 Feb–25 May 2026: ecosystem 31%/120 months + community 10%/48 months = ~0.47% of supply per month x 3 = 1.4% of supply / 17.5% circulating. Assumes linear streams run from TGE; investor/team/advisor cliffs are not until Jan 2027.

unlock_12m_pct_of_circ.note: to 24 Feb 2027: ecosystem 3.1% + community 2.5% + 10% cliff on 51% insiders (5.1%) at Jan 2027 + ~1.1 months of post-cliff linear (45.9%/24 x 1.1 = 2.1%) = 12.8% of supply / 17.5% circulating. Schedule ceiling; how the 17.5% TGE float was sourced from these buckets is not disclosed (see K09).

price_to_last_round_multiple.note: $0.030 / $0.0063 average investor cost (pre-seed + seed blended); the seed-round price alone was not disclosed
